caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, elaborate women's gown displayed on a headless mannequin form, rendered in shades of pink, cream, and grey with vertical striped patterns. The gown features a fitted bodice with a square neckline, trimmed with lace-like detailing, and a center front panel with decorative ruffles and gathers. The sleeves are elbow-length with wide, ruffled cuffs also adorned with lace or ribbon accents. The skirt is voluminous, extending widely at the hips, suggesting the use of panniers or similar understructure, and is composed of alternating bands of light pink, darker pink, and pale grey. An outer skirt is gathered away from the center to reveal the similarly striped underskirt, both bordered with trim. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small pencil sketch of the dress seen from the back, showing a long, trailing train and additional ruffle decoration on the sleeves. The illustration is set against a plain, light background and framed by a thin border.
title: Dress
